pages.text: “A field of purple blossoms, a soothing aroma, swift steps, and fortune by your side.”$(br2)Lavender Tea is a refreshing and calming drink made from dried lavender and sugar. Drinking it provides a temporary Speed and Luck boost, making travelers both agile and fortunate on their journey.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Lavender Tea, $(br)boil dried lavender with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed when traveling or seeking fortune, ensuring a smoother journey.

Upon drinking Lavender Tea, travelers receive a temporary Speed and Luck effect, making movement lighter and bringing a stroke of luck.$(br)This tea is perfect for exploration and seizing opportunities.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
